slides.texte_overlay:
Lost manners every man
should bring back

1. Cap off at the table

Indoors, at dinner.
A small sign of respect.

2. Answering invitations

Yes or no, within a day.
Then show up if you said yes.

3. Walking guests to the door

Not waving from the couch.
The goodbye counts too.

4. Calling with big news

Births, losses, good jobs.
Not a text.

5. Sending condolences

A short message, a card.
People remember who reached out.

6. Asking before
you take a photo

Not everyone wants
to be your content.

7. Being good company

Have a story, a question,
something new to share.
slides.texte_sophia:
7. Being good company

I learn one new thing a day
on the Sophia app. Always
something to share.
